members.name: sector_pair_mean_reversion_v1
members.thesis: Highly correlated stocks within the same sector (e.g., HDFCBANK/ICICIBANK, TCS/INFY) temporarily diverge due to asynchronous order flow, then converge as sector-level information equilibrates. The spread between normalized prices of two co-integrated stocks reverts to its mean within 30-90 minutes d
entry_long: spread_zscore < -2.0 (spread is 2 SD below mean — stock A is cheap vs B)
spread_halflife < 60 (mean reversion is expected within 60 bars)
entry_short: spread_zscore > 2.0 (spread is 2 SD above mean — stock A is rich vs B)
members.exit_stop: spread_zscore reaches ±3.0 (spread widens further — cut loss)
filters: vix < 22
no trades first 15 min or last 15 min
both legs must have volume > 50% of their 20-bar avg
none — market neutral
skip if either leg has spread > 0.1%
weaknesses: Two-leg execution doubles cost: 2x slippage, 2x brokerage, 2x STT — total ~25 bps per pair trade
Co-integration breaks during regime changes — a pair that worked last month may diverge permanently
Leg risk: one leg fills, the other doesn't, leaving you with a naked directional position
members.prior_art: Classic pairs trading (Gatev, Goetzmann, Rouwenhorst 2006). Indian market adaptation.

members.name: pairs_trading_it_v1
members.thesis: TCS and INFOSYS are the two largest Indian IT services companies with 60%+ revenue from North America, similar client verticals, and near-identical FX exposure (USD/INR). Intraday divergences arise from differential order flow (mutual fund rebalancing, FII block deals) rather than fundamental shifts
members.exit_stop: z_score exceeds 3.0 OR loss > 0.4% of capital_per_trade
filters: India_VIX < 20; skip if VIX > 20
no new entries after 14:00 IST (IT stocks lose volume post-lunch)
both legs 1-min volume > 10000 shares at entry
NIFTY_IT not moving > 1.5% intraday at time of entry
bid-ask spread < 0.03% on both legs
weaknesses: USD/INR moves can cause structural pair divergence that lasts beyond intraday (e.g., sharp INR depreciation benefits TCS more due to higher US revenue share)
Lower intraday volatility in IT large-caps means the spread moves slowly; many signals may not reach target before time stop
Quarterly guidance divergence (TCS guiding up while INFY guides down) can break the pair for weeks, and residual positioning effects linger intraday
members.prior_art: Standard distance-method pairs (Gatev et al. 2006); IT sector pair adaptation with FX filter inspired by Huck & Afawubo (2015) currency-adjusted pairs

filters: vix < 24

members.name: relative_reversion_v1
members.universe: NIFTY 200 constituents, grouped by GICS sector
members.thesis: Within a sector (e.g., private banks), the intraday return spread between the strongest and weakest stock tends to revert after reaching an extreme. members.exit_stop: relative_zscore reaches ±3.0 (divergence deepening) OR 0.5% loss on the leg
filters: none — relative trades are market-neutral-ish
no entries before 10:00 (need relative data to stabilize) or after 14:30
both stocks in the pair must have adequate volume
prefer trades when the sector is range-bound (|sector_median_return| < 1%)
bid-ask spread < 0.05% on both legs

no trades first 15 min or last 20 min
volume > 80% of 20-bar avg

members.name: pairs_trading_bank_v1
members.thesis: HDFCBANK and ICICIBANK are structurally linked: both are large-cap private banks with overlapping loan books, similar NIM profiles, and high institutional overlap. Their intraday spread (log price ratio) mean-reverts within the session because fundamental news rarely justifies a >1-sigma divergence
